scripts.check: prettier --check . && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
scripts.ext:zip: node extension/build.mjs && rm -f extension/lateshow-extension.zip && cd extension/dist && zip -qr ../lateshow-extension.zip . && cd ../.. && pnpm ext:source
scripts.ext:source: rm -f extension/lateshow-extension-source.zip && git archive --format=zip -o extension/lateshow-extension-source.zip HEAD extension/src extension/build.mjs extension/manifest.template.json extension/popup.html extension/icon.png extension/SOURCE.md src/lib/library/importing.ts src/lib/watchProgress.ts src/app/icon.svg package.json pnpm-lock.yaml pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.json
